name: integrations-core
install: uv pip install -q --python {py} pytest pytest-asyncio pytest-mock mock freezegun requests-mock pytest-benchmark pytest-cov

uv pip install -q --python {py} --no-deps -e ./datadog_checks_base -e ./datadog_checks_dev $(for d in */; do test -f $d/pyproject.toml && test -d $d/datadog_checks && test $d != datadog_checks_base/ && test $d != datadog_checks_dev/ && echo -e ./$d; done)

ci.source: one test job per changed integration in CI; 4 vCPU assumed
